text: これ　たのまれてるんだけど　わたして　くれるかい！

structure.jp: これ　たのまれてるんだけど
structure.en: I've been asked to handle this, but

structure.jp: わたして　くれるかい！
structure.en: will you hand it over for me?

patterns.name: 〜られる (passive)
patterns.explanation: The れ in the verb turns 'ask' into 'be asked', and てる (short for ている) says that is still the situation. たのまれてる = 'I have been asked'.

patterns.name: 〜てくれる
patterns.explanation: くれる after a て-form verb says someone does the thing as a favour to the speaker. わたして　くれる = 'hand it over for me'.

patterns.name: 〜のだけど
patterns.span: たのまれてるんだけど
patterns.explanation: んだけど gives background before a request and softens what comes next. たのまれてるんだけど = 'I've been asked to do this, so...'
